coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (<=30 y) solid tumour basket (neuroblastoma, DSRCT, exploratory solid/CNS tumours, DIPG). Glioblastoma is named only as one possible histology of pontine high-grade glioma in the DIPG cohort inclusion criterion; coded basket_gbm_eligible per manual D27B with an uncertainty flag for adjudication. The DIPG arm text says repotrectinib monotherapy although the registry lists irinotecan/temozolomide as interventions of that arm; chemo arms for the backbone rows exclude the DIPG arm accordingly, and the DIPG arm role of repotrectinib would be experimental_monotherapy with regimen monotherapy. ALK/ROS/NTRK status is tested but a specific aberration is not required for the exploratory cohort (NTRK row coded exploratory). ALK-mutated cohort match to repotrectinib relies on drug knowledge (ALK/ROS1/NTRK inhibitor); the record does not state the target. Irinotecan and temozolomide are registered as one combined entry and split here into two rows, not as a fixed-dose combination.
